resources.string: Client for Macro Deck 3 (based on the Macro Deck 2 app). Uses the web client built into the host.
No host found yet. Make sure Macro Deck 3 is running and network discovery is on, or enter the address manually.
IP, IP:port or connect link (default port 8193)
The pairing code is shown next to the QR code in Macro Deck 3 → Network. Without a code you sign in with your Macro Deck 3 account.
